notes.title: Spread the word! Bacon Tales to release october 12th
notes.notes:
Our new game, Bacon Tales - Between Pigs and Wolves will be released on october 12th!! Support us at our Thunderclap campaing to spread the word!

It's simple and at no costs, just a few clicks to join the campaing!

[olist]
Visit our Thunderclap campaing page
Click on ADD MY SUPPORT
Choose witch social media to join the campaing
DONE!!!
[/olist]

Be a part of it!! Spread the word!!!

notes.title: Stair issues - First update coming soon!
notes.notes:
We are working on STS first update.

Some people are having problems using stairs, especially when going down. This issue waste precious seconds to save the inhabtants. Please, do not be angry with us. :(

So, we are thinking about a better way to "stairs using" and it will be released in the next update.

Thanks for playing STS
